one_sentence_story: Across seven experiments in 2014 and 2017 brain-imaging follow-ups, Ethan Kross showed that shifting silent inner speech from 'I' to 'You' or your own first name creates instant psychological distance — lowering emotional threat reactivity within one second and boosting real-world performance under stress.
so_what_for_you: Next time your chest tightens before a tough conversation or presentation, silently coach yourself by your own first name ('Okay [Name], take one breath — what's step one?') just as you would steady a close friend.
